session.title: Cursor CLI and Antigravity CLI accounts; quota history; 1.0.42 released with macOS DMG
session.purpose: Carry out worker_brief_cursor_agy.md (SW306): add Cursor CLI and Antigravity CLI account switching. Then, at the user's request: look up the Codex accounts' last weekly reset, keep each account's quota readings (SW307), and ship and release everything including macOS.
outcomes: SW306 done (1.0.41): Cursor and Antigravity tabs. A provider is only the CLI's login: Cursor = %APPDATA%/Cursor/auth.json + cli-config.json authInfo (other CLI settings kept; the Cursor IDE keeps its own login in state.vscdb and is unaffected); Antigravity = Credential Manager entry gemini:antigravity (Win32 CredRead/CredWrite). Switch-away backfill and the current card's identity read follow the Codex rules (services/login_account.rs). Cursor's 60-day session token has no renewal; Google does not rotate agy's refresh token, so stored copies stay valid. Usage: Cursor DashboardService/GetCurrentPeriodUsage (Included/Auto/API); Antigravity v1internal:fetchAvailableModels with an 'antigravity' user agent. No proxy, pooling, MCP, skills or sessions for them.

Verified on the workstation: each tab imported registered2nd@gmail.com; Enable rewrote byte-identical logins; cursor-agent status reports the account; agy loaded the written login, renewed it and authenticated as registered2nd@gmail.com; both cards show usage. Switching between two different accounts is untested (one account of each).

Codex weekly windows: user-b.zhang reset 10/24 23:14 and registered2nd 23:24 (next 10/31). registered2nd hit the 99% rotation threshold at 21:39 after carrying the week; user-b served 21:42 onward (3,650 requests 21:39-23:14). Pre-reset percentages were not recoverable because quota readings were in memory only.
SW307 done (1.0.42): every whole-point change in a Claude/Codex window's used share, or a new window, is written to quota_readings in switchy.db (90 days). Recording confirmed live for both apps.

Release: GitHub push protection refused the agy OAuth client id/secret embedded in source; they are now read at runtime from the installed agy binary (renewal of an expired token verified), and publish_public.sh replaces the two earlier literals in public history. v1.0.42 published as Latest on registered2nd/switchy with setup.exe, msi and the aarch64 DMG (macOS workflow run 40175291301); it carries 1.0.40 and 1.0.41, which were never published separately. Private origin and public main pushed.
Workstation runs 1.0.42 (installed 2026-10-25 01:00). The laptop stays on 1.0.40 with Switchy quit; another user's PC and Mac stay on 1.0.39; none was asked to be updated.
Claude is no longer locked on registered2nd: account_locks is empty and rotation has moved Claude since 2026-10-21 10:34, before this session.

Known test failures, not fixed: update_current_claude_provider_syncs_live_... needs port 15721 (held by the installed Switchy); usage_rollup::test_rollup_merges_with_existing failed on unmodified main too (passed in a later run); two codex_engine tests are load-sensitive.
session.latest_summary: 1.0.42 released (Windows + macOS): Cursor CLI and Antigravity CLI account switching, quota history in switchy.db, restart after a crash.

current_focus.summary: Switchy 1.0.42 is released (GitHub Latest, Windows installers and Apple Silicon DMG) and runs on the workstation: Cursor CLI and Antigravity CLI account switching, quota readings kept in switchy.db, and Windows restarting Switchy after a crash. The laptop has 1.0.40 with Switchy quit; another user's PC and Mac have 1.0.39. Await the user's feedback; the confirmations below stay pending under their triggers.

next_actions.summary: CONFIRM THE CRASH RESTART ON THE NEXT REAL CRASH (1.0.40). After any Switchy crash on the workstation: Application log event 1000 for switchy.exe, then within about a minute a new switchy.log starting with '[crash_restart] Windows will restart Switchy after a crash or hang' and the proxy on 15721 without a manual start; switchy.prev.log ends at the crash; ~/.switchy/crash.log gains an [ABNORMAL EXIT] entry naming the exception, any 'Windows ran out of memory' line and the dump path. A restart that did not happen while commit was still exhausted is the known single-attempt limit (finding doc option 2 is the backstop).

Confirm account-proxy coverage on the next natural Claude sign-in or renewal while Owen is selected, without forcing a new login. Claude Code's own exchange should log '[connect_tunnel] platform.claude.com:443 via socks5://82.26.163.142:45001'. For Switchy's renewal, observe '[claude_pool] refreshing login for provider=98e00f12...' and the successful refreshed-login message; the enforced per-account client route is owned by proxy/http_client.rs. Windows/WSL HTTPS_PROXY and NO_PROXY, UK exit probes and telemetry tunnels were verified; a live sign-in/renewal using this route remains unobserved. Connection failures must stop rather than fall back to direct; country observations only warn.

CONFIRM THE RESTART PATH ON STEPHEN'S NEXT WINDOWS RESTART (1.0.29). In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.prev.log after 'Session ending; handing the live configs back': '[session-end] claude/codex/gemini handed back', '[session-end] ... in WSL handed back', then 'Live configs handed back for the session end'. 'did not finish in 4 seconds' with the last [session-end] line shows which step stalls (Windows step = database lock, WSL step = WSL I/O); fix that step. In switchy.log: Switchy started within seconds of login (window hidden, launched with --autostart from HKCU Run), '[auto_launch] start at login on', proxy on 15721, and Claude Code / Codex answer without ECONNREFUSED.

CONFIRM CLAUDE LOGINS STAY IN STEP WITH WSL (1.0.27). In switchy.log, when an account WSL is signed in to renews: '[claude_pool] provider=... took the newer login from WSL' or 'wrote the refreshed login through to WSL', and no new 'invalid_grant' 'Refresh token not found or invalid' in account_switches/provider_health. WSL's ~/.claude/.credentials.json and ~/.switchy/accounts/<id>/credentials.json for that account should carry the same refreshToken after each renewal.

CONFIRM ROTATION AND CODEX FAILOVER ON LIVE TRAFFIC (1.0.25/1.0.26). In C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log and the switchy.db account_switches table: (a) when an account's five-hour window resets while another serves, a switch back to it with reason 'recovered' and detail "Another account's weekly limit resets sooner"; (b) a Codex turn refused for usage that continues an earlier one logs '[CodexWS] provider=... websocket closed (turn refused for usage; Codex resends it in full)' and the turn then completes on the next account with no error in Codex. GET http://127.0.0.1:15721/switchy/accounts shows current account, pool order, quota and atLimit per account.

VERIFY LOCAL PROXY OFF WITH AN OPEN CODEX WINDOW. the user was asked to turn Local proxy off in Settings > Pool, then use a Codex window opened while the proxy was on. Confirm in C:/Users/Administrator/.switchy/logs/switchy.log that "Proxy turned off; its listener stays up..." was logged, that the Codex window's later [Codex] requests still reached the proxy and answered, that netstat shows 127.0.0.1:15721 still LISTENING, and that Settings shows the proxy as off. Turning it back on must reuse the listener.

QUIT CASE WAITS ON STEPHEN. Quitting Switchy still breaks Codex windows opened under the proxy. He was offered a warning on quit naming the open Codex windows (small) or running the proxy as a process that outlives Switchy's window (large); he has not chosen. Build nothing until he does.
If the user directs request logging to be enabled, first make the Usage page's Turn on button apply to the running proxy, then enable it for Claude, Codex, and Gemini.

CONFIRM SWITCHING BETWEEN TWO CURSOR OR ANTIGRAVITY ACCOUNTS when the user adds a second account (1.0.41+). Only one account of each exists, so only capture and re-enable of the same account was verified. On the second account's card: enable it, sign in (cursor-agent login / agy), switch back to the first card and check: switchy.log has no '[cursor_account] live login (...) is not the account' or '[antigravity_account] ...' refusal for a normal switch; cursor-agent status names the first account; agy's log (--log-file) shows 'authenticated successfully as' the first account; each card keeps its own email and usage badge. A refusal line during a genuine account change is the backfill guard working, not a fault.
